top_choice_rationale: Optical lattice clocks join the decisive magic-wavelength confinement principle to a defining, independently reproducible experimental capability with exceptional systematic control. Katori and Ye are the most defensible compact attribution if the citation remains confined to the invention and realization of lattice clocks.
